changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0031. Restore the system exercise catalog. Workout generation rejects every plan when no active exercise exists, which is why the coach returned ai.invalid_output. These are the same system rows from LF-0018, inserted only when the id is missing. Index review: PK_Exercises, UX_Exercises_SystemName, and IX_Exercises_Catalog already cover these rows. Performance note: twelve catalog inserts, each guarded by the primary key.
